name: dongle-incremental-codec-recognition-and-570d
instr:
dongle cannot recognize or automatically decode mixed Base32, Base45, Base58, Base62, Base85, Base91, and Base100 input. Add codec-neutral evidence, deterministic selection, and inspectable ambiguity or failure for byte-backed and replayable file-backed values through the fluent facade.

Implement `Probe(src, final)` in `github.com/dromara/dongle/coding/base32`, `base45`, `base58`, `base62`, `base85`, `base91`, and `base100`. Validate prefixes incrementally. Apply each codec's grouping, padding, leading-zero, terminal-unit, bit-reservoir, numeric-range, and UTF-8 rules, and classify terminal fragments independently.

Rank rejection, completeness, canonicality, and valid-prefix evidence without rejecting valid incomplete input. Registration order must not break semantic ties.

`github.com/dromara/dongle/coding` exposes `Codec`, `Candidate`, `Detection`, `DetectOption`, `DetectOptions`, `DefaultCodecs`, `WithCodecs`, `Detect`, `Decoder.ByAuto`, and `Decoder.Detection`. `DefaultCodecs()` returns every named codec exactly once. Each identity uses its explicit selector's byte and streaming decoders. Restricted candidates keep unchanged evidence and use the requested selector.

A unique winner decodes fully and exposes its `Detection`. Ambiguity returns no bytes and an `AmbiguousEncodingError` carrying `Detection Detection`. Unknown or unreplayable input returns no bytes and an `UnknownEncodingError` carrying `Detection Detection`. Preserve every tied candidate and each rejection's
